rough_request: 팝펑크 느낌 빼고, 바탕화면 음악샘플을 중심 motif/response/texture로 써서 전체를 수노처럼 새로 생성된 디지코어/하이퍼팝 곡처럼 재구성. SYSTEM SEOUL/ycs 인접 질감은 broad texture only. 원곡 스테레오는 분위기만 살리고 리드 훅은 새 synth/sample motif가 중심. 랜덤 AI 전환 줄이고 2분 이내 훅 먼저.

chord_options.name: early hook lift
chord_options.feel: playful digital motif color without exact sample or melody copy
notes: Keep the top note simple enough for a bright hook melody.

chord_options.name: two-chord pressure
chord_options.feel: loopable tension that leaves space for vocal and 808
notes: Move energy with rhythm, counterline, and drum density instead of adding too many chords.
Confirm bass root by ear when key confidence is low.

chord_options.name: ambiguous major lift
chord_options.feel: minor/major ambiguity for bright melancholic color
notes: Works best when the melody chooses one strong landing note.
Avoid recreating any known reference melody or exact chord voicing.

melody_ideas.shape: short bright motif with one memorable landing note
melody_ideas.range_hint: mid-high lead register; avoid masking lead vocal
melody_ideas.rhythm_hint: front-load hook within first 15 seconds when short-form is requested
safety_notes: Create a new melody contour; do not copy exact reference melodies.
If vocal_to_code exists, use phrase placement cues only, not exact transcription.

melody_ideas.shape: two-note answer phrase after the vocal or hook call
melody_ideas.range_hint: above bass and below vocal air band
melody_ideas.rhythm_hint: answer on empty beats, not over every vocal syllable
safety_notes: Confirm against the estimated key by ear before committing.

bassline_ideas.pattern: root-weighted hits with short fills into hook downbeats
bassline_ideas.upper_harmonics_width: allowed only above the sub range
safety_notes: Do not copy exact reference basslines or kick/bass samples.
Stereo-only source does not prove true kick/bass replacement.

bassline_ideas.pattern: half-time held root notes for verse or breakdown contrast
bassline_ideas.upper_harmonics_width: narrow unless hook needs extra lift
safety_notes: Confirm roots by ear when key confidence is low.

drum_ideas.kick: short punchy kick supporting 808 without clipping
drum_ideas.hats: game-like rhythmic color as high-level trait only
safety_notes: Do not copy exact reference drum patterns.
Avoid random AI glitch and cheap rage clipping.

drum_ideas.variation: remove one drum lane before hook return
safety_notes: Use as programming guidance only; no true drum rewrite is claimed.
